description: This file defines a REST API class for SQL Lab in Apache Superset, handling endpoints for bootstrap data, query estimation, SQL formatting, exporting results, and executing SQL queries, including streaming exports and asynchronous execution.

classes.name: SqlLabRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints for SQL Lab functionalities such as bootstrap data, query estimation, SQL formatting, exporting results, and executing SQL queries, including streaming and asynchronous options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve bootstrap data for SQL Lab page, assembling initial state including active tab, databases, queries, and tab state IDs.

methods.name: estimate_query_cost
methods.description: Endpoint to estimate the execution cost of a SQL query based on provided parameters.

methods.name: format_sql
methods.description: Endpoint to format a SQL query, optionally processing Jinja templates with provided parameters.

methods.name: export_csv
methods.description: Endpoint to export SQL query results to CSV file.

methods.name: export_streaming_csv
methods.description: Endpoint to export SQL query results as a streaming CSV for large datasets.

methods.name: _create_streaming_csv_response
methods.description: Helper method to create a streaming CSV response with appropriate headers and generator.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the results of a SQL query execution.

methods.name: execute_sql_query
methods.description: Endpoint to execute a SQL query, supporting synchronous and asynchronous execution modes.

methods.name: _create_sql_json_command
methods.description: Factory method to create an ExecuteSqlCommand with proper context and dependencies.

methods.name: _create_sql_json_executor
methods.description: Factory method to create an SQL JSON executor, choosing between asynchronous and synchronous implementations based on execution context.
